minimap.screen.title: Map
minimap.screen.hint: M or Esc to close  ·  drag to pan  ·  scroll to zoom
minimap.config.title: Minimap settings
minimap.config.mini_radius.tooltip: Distance, in blocks, from the player to each edge of the minimap (8 to 128).
minimap.config.mini_size.tooltip: Side of the minimap on screen, in pixels (48 to 256).
minimap.config.rotate.tooltip: On, the minimap rotates with the camera and the player always looks up. Off, north is always up.
minimap.config.map_radius.tooltip: Distance, in blocks, from the centre to each edge of the expanded map (32 to 256).
minimap.config.show_coordinates.tooltip: Shows the player coordinates above the minimap.
minimap.config.show_compass.tooltip: Shows the cardinal points around the minimap.
minimap.config.show_players.tooltip: Shows other players in the world as dots on the map.
minimap.config.show_respawn.tooltip: Shows the respawn point (bed or anchor) on the map.
minimap.config.allow_multiplayer.tooltip: Enables the minimap on remote servers too. Many servers ban map mods that show players.
